events.text:
Red: do not sign as it is. Biggest reason: 24-month automatic renewals with 90 days' notice, while the supplier can raise prices at will.

Jurisdiction used: the Netherlands (clause 9.1, the Supplier's registered office in Utrecht).

| Severity | Clause | Plain meaning | Change to ask for |
|---|---|---|---|
| High | 2.2 "...renews automatically for a further term of 24 months, unless the Customer gives written notice of cancellation at least 90 days before the end of the then-current term." | Miss the date and you are tied in for two years. | 12 months, 30 days' notice. |
| High | 3.2 "The Supplier may change the fees at its discretion at any time..." | Prices can rise at any time. | Only at renewal, with notice and a right to cancel. |

This is a first review, not legal advice. For important decisions, consult a qualified lawyer in your jurisdiction.
